Hi Sahil / Marta —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, we'd like to run a focused architecture review with your infra and security teams to walk through the integration pattern, network diagram, and data flow (ingress/egress, retention, and KMS). Suggested goals:

- Validate the proposed VPC peering and egress controls
- Walk through the model serving topology and cache strategies
- Confirm audit-log and retention expectations for SOC2 readiness

Proposed length: 60 minutes (40m presentation + 20m Q&A). Are any of these windows workable for you?

- Tue Dec 14, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Dec 15, 09:00–10:00 PT

Attached: readpack-v1.2.pdf (short summary + architecture bullets), arch-diagram-v4.png (network + zones), runbook-draft.md (an initial ops checklist we’ll use during the review). Drive folder and calendar placeholder links below.

If those slots don't work, tell me two alternatives and we’ll accommodate. I’ll coordinate the final agenda and who presents which section.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Evelyn —

Adding the retention mapping slide (attached as arch-diagram-v4-retention.png) and updated notes inline in runbook-draft.md. High-level:

- Transient token cache: 0–24 hours (encrypted in GPU host memory; not persisted)
- KV cache (checkpointed shards): retained for 7 days, encrypted with customer KMS by default for Private deployments
- Long-term logs (audit + usage): aggregated and retained per contract (30/90/365 days) — we call out options in the readpack appendix.

I also trimmed the topology slide to call out the egress proxy and allowed ports. Marissa, I left the agenda where you said — please nudge if timing needs to shift.
